title: Solomon's wisdom and learning the Bible
summary: Thomas quotes Solomon on getting wisdom and understanding and says Christian Science made him study the whole Bible.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Life philosophy: faith, karma and how to live

blocks.x: Yeah. It certainly couldn't do anybody any harm, and it certainly did some wonderful... You mentioned something about Solomon, too, didn't you.

Yes. I'll always remember that... You know, Solomon asked God for wisdom. And Solomon was really a brilliant... He was a brilliant man. And I wanted to quote that, and I had to look up the verse that comes near to saying that. He said, 'Wisdom is the principal thing. Therefore, get wisdom, and with all you are getting, get understanding.' Which is important in music. Anything you go into, get to understanding what makes it work. And I... It's important to read that whole...read it from the first chapter to the fourth chapter. Because he deals with so many of those things. He even tells us about, heh-heh... He even advises us about women. Of course, he had quite a few of them.
Well, all of that ...(? )... he said it was very... He was talking about the extent you use a certain amount of (?) on your (?) marriage, but if you can't handle it, like most of us can't...
That all goes in (?) in relation to discord, you see.

Right. Because I didn't know anything about the Bible until I got into Christian Science. And it makes you study... One thing, they study the whole Bible. They don't just study the New Testament or part of it. They take the whole thing, go back so many times to (?0 and Isaiah, and I'm learning about the prophets. You know, my son-in-law is a preacher. So he's been very helpful to me. Every time I'd run out there he'd get some books out -- I'd ask him about somebody. He's got all the different dictionaries and whatnot. Because I'd been interested in finding out about a lot of those early prophets, how the different things came to them.
But we can get into that a little later.
